rows.prompt: A chicken becomes the CEO of a big company.
rows.problem: announces a pecking order
rows.title: Community Surprise 1
rows.story: At the community fair, a chicken CEO announces a pecking order. The organiser checked the rules, checked them again, and decided this was probably allowed. A small queue formed. One neighbour brought a notebook, another brought snacks, and everyone had a sensible suggestion that made the situation less sensible. Finally, the organiser held up a prize and asked who was responsible. Nobody moved. The prize was a free lesson in being normal. The queue immediately disappeared.
